name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (2026-07-04) is a major release with 238 commits, introducing Connect Knowledge for cloud drive integration (Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive, Dropbox), a greatly expanded Integrations Hub with 52 connectors (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), per-room agent Channels, and a Telegram remote-control gateway. Security improvements include PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt and login rate-limiting. v0.6.0 introduces a self-update mechanism, with future releases published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04 with 238 commits, v0.6.0 followed shortly after
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes — password-based auth with PBKDF2 hashing, per-install salt, login rate-limiting, and mobile/reverse-proxy support

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron. Old hash links resolve via a marker-scan parser, but the canonical form is now path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from `.slack` to `.channels`, scoped per room.
v0.6.0: Cabinet now updates itself — future releases are published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases instead of the original repository.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more advanced document management with OCR and tagging but is significantly heavier and more complex to self-host than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a more feature-rich document management system with workflows and metadata but requires more resources and setup than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automated document processing and tagging but has a steeper learning curve and heavier infrastructure footprint compared to Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud is a comprehensive self-hosted cloud platform covering files and more, but it is far heavier and more complex than Cabinet's focused document cabinet approach.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and focused on file browsing with broad storage backend support, but lacks Cabinet's document-centric organization features.
